reason: I already get more barter leads than I can post from my four WhatsApp groups, so I don't need another app badly enough to hand some unknown beta team access to my Instagram. Free is nice, but a small team I've never heard of reading my account is not worth the risk for me.
objection: Connecting my Instagram to an app I don't know feels risky, and 'read-only' plus auto-DMs to my followers sounds like it could mess with my account or get me flagged.
would_change_my_mind: If a couple of creators I actually know from my WhatsApp groups said they got a real paid collab through it and their account was fine.
